description.value: The Polygon Gallery is a contemporary art institution on the North Vancouver waterfront focused on photography and lens-based practices. It moved into its Governor General's Medal-winning building in 2017 after operating as Presentation House Gallery for forty years, and has presented over 300 exhibitions. Admission is always by donation, making it an easy stop for touring cyclists exploring the North Shore.
